name: labs/uw-loci__flamingo_control
title: Flamingo stage position controller (PositionController)
intro: Flamingo stage position controller (PositionController), adapted from uw-loci/flamingo_control. It reads `position_x`, `position_y`, `position_z` and `rotation`; sets `home_x`, `home_y`, `home_z` and `home_rotation`; runs `move_stage` and `stop_motion`. `move_stage`: move all four stage axes to an absolute position with the controller's move_to_position; a target outside the configured stage limits is refused instead of clamped. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
